svg.title: Focus. Architecture: Angular and TypeScript, Native Federation micro-frontends, Server-side rendering and hydration, Signals and RxJS, WCAG 2.1 accessibility. Leadership: Building teams from scratch, Hiring and technical interviews, Mentoring and code review, KPI and performance reviews, AI usage guardrails for teams. Tools: Nx and Storybook, Jasmine and Karma, Docker and GitLab CI, Drupal as a headless CMS, React, Next.js, Vue and Nuxt.
